Modal Dialog

Command Palette

Fast search and navigation palette.

Zero-JS Smooth Accordion (CSS interpolate-size)

By utilizing the modern CSS interpolate-size: allow-keywords rule, Skeletonic expands from height: 0 to height: auto smoothly without calculating scrollHeight in JavaScript.

Accessibility & Keyboard Navigation

Full native keyboard accessibility is built in. Press Tab to focus, Space or Enter to expand or collapse.

The 2026 Native Modal Standard

This modal is rendered in the top-layer using the native HTML5 <dialog> API and animates smoothly via @starting-style with zero JavaScript rendering libraries.

Slide-In Sheet Drawer

Discrete display and transform transitions on HTML5 dialog.

This drawer slides smoothly from the right viewport edge. It includes backdrop dimming, touch safety, and keyboard escape trapping.
